description: TmNotionCommentThreadView Blazor component in the Notion Editor category.

parameters.name: AbsoluteTime
parameters.description: Absolute time for the title.

parameters.name: CanDelete
parameters.description: True when the current user may delete the entry.

parameters.name: CanEdit
parameters.description: True when the current user may edit the entry.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Class of the list root. Defaults to {ClassPrefix}__thread.

parameters.name: ClassPrefix
parameters.description: CSS class prefix of the owning panel.

parameters.name: EditingEntryId
parameters.description: Entry currently being edited.

parameters.name: EditText
parameters.description: Text of the open edit.

parameters.name: FormatBody
parameters.description: Turns an entry body into the markup the panel shows.

parameters.name: FormatTime
parameters.description: Relative time. The parent resolves ITmRelativeTimeFormatter.

parameters.name: HideReplyOnLastEntry
parameters.description: Hides the inline Reply action on the last entry (panels that render a thread-level reply trigger right below the thread).

parameters.name: InlineReplyBaseline
parameters.description: Text that does not count as an inline-reply draft.

parameters.name: InlineReplyResetToken
parameters.description: Bumped by the parent to clear or reseed the inline composer.

parameters.name: InlineReplyText
parameters.description: Seed of the open inline reply (the auto-inserted quote). Not updated per keystroke.

parameters.name: InlineReplyTextChanged
parameters.description: Stores the inline reply text without re-rendering the thread.

parameters.name: LabelPrefix
parameters.description: Localization prefix used when Labels is null.

parameters.name: Labels
parameters.description: Resolved strings. Null reads them from LabelPrefix.

parameters.name: MentionProvider
parameters.description: People provider for @-mentions inside edit and reply composers.

parameters.name: Nodes
parameters.description: Reply tree. The parent builds it.

parameters.name: OnCancelEdit
parameters.description: Raised by the edit cancel.

parameters.name: OnCancelReply
parameters.description: Raised by the inline reply cancel.

parameters.name: OnDelete
parameters.description: Raised by Delete. The parent shows the confirm dialog.

parameters.name: OnDraftChanged
parameters.description: Raised after a draft-bearing field changes, so the parent can publish its snapshot.

parameters.name: OnEdit
parameters.description: Raised by Edit.

parameters.name: OnEditKeyDown
parameters.description: Raised for a keydown inside the edit composer.

parameters.name: OnEditTextChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the edit text changes.

parameters.name: OnEntryKeyDown
parameters.description: Raised for a keydown on an entry row.

parameters.name: OnQuote
parameters.description: Raised by Quote. A delegate shows the menu item.

parameters.name: OnReply
parameters.description: Raised by Reply.

parameters.name: OnSaveEdit
parameters.description: Raised by the edit save.

parameters.name: OnSubmitReply
parameters.description: Raised by the inline reply submit.

parameters.name: Reactions
parameters.description: Reactions fragment. Null hides reactions.

parameters.name: ReplyingToEntryId
parameters.description: Entry currently being replied to.

parameters.name: Submitting
parameters.description: True while a send is in flight.
